title: Clearances.
officialText:
Connectors shall have a minimum clearance to combustibles in accordance with Table 803.10.6. The
clearances specified in Table 803.10.6 apply, except where the listing and labeling of an appliance specifies a different clearance,
in which case the labeled clearance shall apply. The clearance to combustibles for connectors shall be reduced only in accordance
with Section 308 or via the use of a listed chimney or vent connector system.
